definition: An outlet counts if it is on this hand-picked list (news agencies, public and international broadcasters, newspapers of record, specialist humanitarian and migration outlets, UN agencies and NGOs, and respected regional outlets that fill gaps in Latin America, Africa and the Pacific), or if Wikipedia's Perennial Sources list rates it generally reliable. Aggregators, press-release sites, tabloids, and entertainment or finance trade press are blocked. Outlets Wikipedia rates generally unreliable, deprecated or blacklisted are never shown.

tiers.newspaper: Newspaper of record or major national outlet
tiers.humanitarian: Humanitarian or migration specialist, UN agency or NGO
tiers.regional: Regional or national outlet covering a region with few international reporters
